title: Loot Loop
provenance: Reported by ch4vi (highball-db#1387, 2026-11-22), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 83 minutes: with the Steam id given and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes. The first start after installing stopped with a Microsoft C++ runtime error although the runtime was installed, and starting it again without changing anything worked, with no other issues. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: BitBrew's game, released on Steam in April 2026. Reported playable on an M1 Pro with DXMT on the default engine r28 over 83 minutes, after a second start, since the first one stopped with a C++ runtime error.

knownIssues.symptom: The first start after installing stops with a Microsoft C++ runtime error (M1 Pro, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1387)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The vcrun2022 recipe was installed
knownIssues.fix: start the game again, which worked for the reporter without changing anything
